en: Then it is with great pride that I tell you that Brakgul Deathbringer stands ready in the Hall of Arms to aid you on your way to Warsong Gulch. Seek him out in the Valley of Honor.
I was devoured by Horgus!  I can still feel his teeth upon me!

I do not have time to waste, $c; there is a war at Ahn'Qiraj to prepare for. If you are going to help, we are collecting singed corestones from the Molten Core. I need to gather a total of $2110w, and currently have $2109w.
Too long have I sat idle, gripped in this haze... this malaise, lamenting what could have been... what should have been.
I wish to make a purchase, Nipsy.
Obsidion rise and serve your master!
I see the exit! Hurry, hurry!
Uh oh!  I'm out of here!
Tell me more about these hippogryphs.
Who dares disturb my meditation?
RUN! RUN FOR HILLS!
You get down from there right now!  I don't want you climbing that thing.  It's not safe.
Come get yer fresh bread!
Warsong Gulch
I can't handle this $n alone! Help!
Toil not in matters of the past, $n!
Strike me down. I shall be reborn... Even more powerful...
Trying to find out more about these creatures hasn't been easy.  My friend and the person who hired his mercenaries to steal Lord Valthalak's spellbook have both been feared dead for a while.
Neither generals is spawned.
All right, stay close.  These fiends will jump right out of the shadows at you if you let your guard down.
The Kolkar will rule!
Glad to be out of that wretched trench. Not much nicer up here though!
I require a vial of Aqual Quintessence, Hydraxis, for I go to the Molten Core to extinguish a rune of the Firelords
Here goes nothing...
Greetings, $N. I am Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff of the Argent Dawn.
%s laughs at your foolish request.
I'm honored to meet you, $n, but your skill at potions is greater than my own. Go see Doctor Herbert Halsey, an undead in the Apothecarium of the Undercity. He can help you from now on.
Where is the Fishing trainer?

Don't get me wrong, I'd rather not be in a tunnel filled with silithid day in and day out, but if hiding here and watching these creatures' movements is going to help us win the war then I'll do it for as long as it takes.
Enough prattling. Let them come. We shall grind their bones to dust.
Do not forget the sacrifices made on this day, night elf. We have all suffered immensely at the hands of these beasts.
My business plan never accounted for housing giant kodos... maybe I should have gone into the underwater basket weaving business instead.
Shal myrinan ishnu daldorah...
Now where did I put that mysterious fossil? Ah, maybe up there...
Er... that's how I found them.  I wanted to show the king that they were a threat!  Say Captain... I overheard Guard Fengus calling you a fat, useless gnoll lover!
Come in, come in. Just don't sit too close to the stove. It hasn't exploded yet today, but just to be safe I think you should sit elsewhere.

It's just so horrible. Our three top guns were shot down over Alliance territory during an air assault Nobody knows if they're dead or alive!$B$BThis is a terrible blow to our air strike capabilities.
%s has grown to full size!
Steady, people.  We'll raid soon enough.
%s tosses dynamite through the air and it lands near by.
<Gaze into the crystalline tear.>
I don't think one charge is going to cut it. Keep fending them off!
Where can I get Enchanted Thorium?
Fear lies in your heart, $N. When you truly are ready to face Vorsha the Lasher, come speak with me.

Good question, $c. Last I was informed; we have managed to collect $1997w copper bars out of $1998w needed. Additionally, I am told that we have $2002w iron bars out of $2003w, and $2011w out of $2012w thorium bars requested.
